description: A Svelte forgot-password screen from the SvGrid UI kit with two states in one SvCard. The request state has a single email SvTextInput with format validation and a submit SvButton that shows its loading state; the confirmation state names the address, offers a resend button with a 60 second cooldown and a link to try another email. A back-to-sign-in link sits in the card footer in both states.

faq.question: Where do I call my password reset API?
faq.answer: requestReset(addr) near the top of the script is a stand-in that resolves after a second. Replace it with your request, for example fetch('/api/password-reset', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ email: addr }) }), and throw when the response is not ok. Both the first send and the resend button go through it, and a throw shows an error toast.

faq.question: Why does the confirmation say 'if an account exists'?
faq.answer: So the screen does not tell anyone whether an email is registered. Your endpoint should answer the same way for known and unknown addresses, and the block shows the same confirmation either way.

faq.question: How does the resend cooldown work?
faq.answer: A successful send sets cooldown to 60. An $effect runs one setTimeout per second while it is above zero and clears it on unmount. The resend button is disabled and shows Resend in Ns until the count hits zero; a resend restarts the 60 seconds after the new request succeeds.
